environment: Node test runner, python3 branches.py, git with scratch repos and a bare origin under a temp dir; executor runs the prompt's command text with argv, no shell

cases.title: Default format: list returns two attempt branches and delete removes only them
cases.when: Run the list command from integrator.md step 2, filter id S-001, run git branch -D per entry
cases.then: Only the two attempt branches go; sdlc/S-001 and sdlc/S-001-v0 stay
cases.expected: Only the two attempt branches go; sdlc/S-001 and sdlc/S-001-v0 stay
cases.actual: Only the two attempt branches go; sdlc/S-001 and sdlc/S-001-v0 stay

cases.title: Lowercase format: id s-001 matches S-001 case-blind; S-0010 and S-001a stay
cases.then: List prints id s-001; an exact-case filter finds 0; the case-blind filter finds 2; other ids stay
cases.expected: List prints id s-001; an exact-case filter finds 0; the case-blind filter finds 2; other ids stay
cases.actual: List prints id s-001; an exact-case filter finds 0; the case-blind filter finds 2; other ids stay

cases.title: Mixed-case format and letter-suffix id S-027b
cases.given: branchFormat work/{name}, branches for S-027, S-027b, S-027bc

cases.title: Other slices and non-attempt branches survive
cases.given: Branches of S-002, S-0010, S-001a, run-3, verify, user and bare names
cases.then: Only attempt-1 and attempt-12 of S-001 go
cases.expected: Only attempt-1 and attempt-12 of S-001 go
cases.actual: Only attempt-1 and attempt-12 of S-001 go

cases.title: Hostile format prefixes do not break the delete commands
cases.given: Formats with unicode, leading dash, whitespace, shell characters; flag-like corpus branch names
cases.then: Unicode name deletes cleanly; dash-leading and whitespace formats are refused by branches.py; no injected file appears
cases.expected: Unicode name deletes cleanly; dash-leading and whitespace formats are refused by branches.py; no injected file appears
cases.actual: Unicode name deletes cleanly; dash-leading and whitespace formats are refused by branches.py; no injected file appears

cases.title: pr/mr/stack: remote attempt ref vanishes, missing remote ref is tolerated
cases.given: Bare origin holds attempt-1 only; attempt-2 is local
cases.when: Run local delete and git push origin --delete for each
cases.then: attempt-1 vanishes on origin; push for attempt-2 exits 1 with 'remote ref does not exist' and the run continues; S-002 ref stays
cases.expected: attempt-1 vanishes on origin; push for attempt-2 exits 1 with 'remote ref does not exist' and the run continues; S-002 ref stays
cases.actual: attempt-1 vanishes on origin; push for attempt-2 exits 1 with 'remote ref does not exist' and the run continues; S-002 ref stays

cases.title: Direct mode text names no push and no push happens
cases.given: Prompt step 2 text; origin holds attempt-1
cases.then: Text lists only pr, mr and stack; origin keeps its ref
cases.expected: Text lists only pr, mr and stack; origin keeps its ref
cases.actual: Text lists only pr, mr and stack; origin keeps its ref

cases.title: No origin remote: failed push does not stop the other deletions
cases.when: Run delete and push for two attempt branches
cases.then: Both local branches go; push exits non-zero
cases.expected: Both local branches go; push exits non-zero
cases.actual: Both local branches go; push exits non-zero

cases.title: Parent walk: step 3 text and per-parent list under a custom format
cases.given: S-013 and its children S-013a, S-013b under feature/{name:lower}
cases.when: Run step 2 for the parent id, then for S-013a
cases.then: Parent attempts go, child attempts stay until their own id runs; text keeps splitInto and never-delete-unfinished
cases.expected: Parent attempts go, child attempts stay until their own id runs; text keeps splitInto and never-delete-unfinished
cases.actual: Parent attempts go, child attempts stay until their own id runs; text keeps splitInto and never-delete-unfinished

attacks.name: hostile branch formats
attacks.result: dash-leading, double-dash and whitespace formats are refused; unicode works; shell characters are accepted by the format (seed)

seeds.title: Prompt writes git branch -D <branch> unquoted; branches.py accepts shell characters in a format
seeds.detail: A branchFormat such as f$(id)/{name} or f;id;/{name} passes branches.py name. An agent that pastes the listed branch into a shell without quotes would run the text. The format is owner-controlled, so the risk is low. Quote the branch in the prompt.

seeds.title: A failed git push origin --delete exits 1 for a missing ref
seeds.detail: The prompt says a missing name is fine. An agent must read exit 1 plus 'remote ref does not exist' as fine and still continue. The prompt does not say to continue after any failure of step 2 for one branch, though step 4 sends failures to notes.

seeds.title: branches.py list reads local branches only
seeds.detail: A remote-only attempt branch stays on origin. The plan records this limit in its risks.
